import numpy as np

a = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4])
b = np.array([2, -1, 0, 1])
c = np.array([1, 0, -1, 2])

u1 = a.copy()

proj_u1_b = (np.dot(a, b) / np.dot(a, a)) * a
u2 = b - proj_u1_b

proj_u1_c = (np.dot(a, c) / np.dot(a, a)) * a
proj_u2_c = (np.dot(u2, c) / np.dot(u2, u2)) * u2
u3 = c - proj_u1_c - proj_u2_c

e1 = u1 / np.linalg.norm(u1)
e2 = u2 / np.linalg.norm(u2)
e3 = u3 / np.linalg.norm(u3)

ortho_12 = np.dot(e1, e2)
ortho_13 = np.dot(e1, e3)
ortho_23 = np.dot(e2, e3)

A_ortho = np.column_stack([e1, e2, e3])
P = A_ortho @ A_ortho.T

v = np.array([5, 3, 1, 0])
proj_v = P @ v

print(f"Orthogonal vectors:")
print(f"u1 = {u1}")
print(f"u2 = {u2}")
print(f"u3 = {u3}")
print(f"Orthogonality checks: {ortho_12:.2e}, {ortho_13:.2e}, {ortho_23:.2e}")
print(f"Projection of v: {proj_v}")
